## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Toledo, United States. It starts at 2 Hippo Way, Toledo.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into the wild at Toledo Zoo, a place for unique animal encounters and experiences. Recognized throughout the world for its conservation and breeding successes, the Toledo Zoo is leading the way to a better planet.
>
> Watch elephants, hippos, tigers, bears, gorillas, crocodiles, snakes, and an amazing array of rare birds. The Toledo Zoo cares for over 10,000 animals from 720 species!
>
> “Dive” into the wonder of 3,000+ aquatic animals in 178,000 gallons of water in the state of the art Aquarium then “reach for the starfish” in the Aquarium’s interactive touch tank.
>
> Satisfy your cravings with Toledo Zoo favorites at the Beastro Beer & Wine Garden. Enjoy upscale food offerings at the Monarch Café. Then find the perfect souvenir at the North Star Trading Post or one of several other pop-up shops within the park.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €32.72. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 125 ratings and 49 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
